nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs only for production workflow failures linked through settings.errorWorkflow. Manual tests do not trigger it.

nodes.name: Build safe error alert
nodes.notes: Builds a metadata-only alert and suppresses repeats for six hours. Raw errors, stacks and execution payloads are excluded.

nodes.name: Send error alert
nodes.notes: Bind the existing coach SMTP credential. No raw error data is transmitted.

nodes.name: Record successful alert
nodes.notes: Writes the cooldown timestamp only after SMTP succeeds.
